forbidden_dependency_rules.name: ui_no_player
forbidden_dependency_rules.description: ui must not depend on player modules directly (downward-skip purity: layer order allows ui(3)->player as a legal downward edge, so this ban is NOT covered by the layer gate — retained)

forbidden_dependency_rules.name: ui_no_computer
forbidden_dependency_rules.description: ui must not depend on computer modules directly (downward-skip purity: layer order allows ui(3)->computer as a legal downward edge, so this ban is NOT covered by the layer gate — retained)

forbidden_dependency_rules.name: ui_no_rules
forbidden_dependency_rules.description: ui must not depend on rules modules directly (downward-skip purity: layer order allows ui(3)->rules as a legal downward edge, so this ban is NOT covered by the layer gate — retained)

forbidden_dependency_rules.name: ui_schema_pure
forbidden_dependency_rules.description: ui schema must stay pure and only depend on inner modules / shared seams (intra-ui sub-view purity + cross-layer; NOT covered by layer order — retained as an explicit rule)

forbidden_dependency_rules.name: ui_state_no_coord
forbidden_dependency_rules.description: ui.state owns presentation state and must not depend on ui.coord, which consumes it and drives view/host side effects (intra-ui direction; layer order treats both as ui(3) so this is NOT covered by the layer gate — retained)

forbidden_dependency_rules.name: ui_no_turn_loop
forbidden_dependency_rules.description: ui must not depend on the turn loop, which calls into ui (turn -> ui runtime direction); the input-lock predicate lives in src.state.input_lock (#206 C / #211). Layer order allows ui(3)->turn(4) as a legal downward edge, so this ban is NOT covered by the layer gate
